newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stock market closed for national holiday.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stock market closed for national holiday.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market is closed on Monday for a national holiday. The market will reopen on Tuesday.

On Friday, the key Nikkei 225 average closed 119.79 points or 0.61 percent higher at 19,690.46 after see-sawing in positive and negative territory towards the close. But its March futures lost 70 points to close at 19,590.
